name: Modal task
description:
**Summary**

1. Reported issue: the Sprint/Kanban task-creation modal could only be dismissed with its "Cancel" button — no title bar, no close affordance, no backdrop dismissal.
2. Root cause: `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue` was opened with a `modal` contract (`#header` slot, `fullscreen` prop, valueless `close`) that the shared `src/components/Modal.vue` never implemented.
3. Fix delivered entirely in `src/components/Modal.vue`: declared `fullscreen`, rendered a header bar with an accessible ✕ button when a `header` slot exists, and tolerated the bare `close` attribute.
4. Added backdrop click-to-close for closable modals, while keeping the legacy absolute top-right ✕ so the ~20 other dialogs using the component look and behave unchanged.
5. Remaining TODO flagged: `Modal.vue` still lacks `Escape` handling, a focus trap, and `role="dialog"` / `aria-modal="true"`.

messages.content: Fix how task creation modal is opened

## 1. Review & Understand the Task - Sprint / Kanban **task-creation dialog** (`SprintBoardModals.vue`) is opened with: ```html ``` - The dialog is written against a `modal` contract that the **globally registered `src/components/Modal.vue` does not implement**: - `#header` slot → never rendered (Modal only renders the default slot) ⇒ the dialog opens with **no title**. - `fullscreen` prop → not declared, so it falls into `$attrs` and is emitted as a stray `fullscreen="false"`/`"true"` HTML attribute ⇒ the documented "compact/full-viewport" behaviour never happens. - `close` passed as a **valueless** attribute (every other modal in the app uses `close="true"`) ⇒ the close affordance is not reliably rendered. - No backdrop dismissal at all. - Net effect: the modal is "opened" in a state that is missing its chrome (title + close), which is exactly the reported symptom ("can only be closed with Cancel"). **Acceptance criteria** - Opening the task dialog renders its header (title + urgent badge) and a close button. - `fullscreen` works when the dialog is opened in `compact` mode. - Clicking the dimmed backdrop closes it. - No behaviour change for the other ~20 modals that use the component today. ## 2. Information Gathering Already in the conversation (no extra discovery needed): | File | Relevant facts | |---|---| | `src/components/Modal.vue` | `props: ['close']`, `inheritAttrs: false`, `v-bind="$attrs"` on the inner box, absolute X button `v-if="close"`, `mounted()` appends `$el` to `$root.$el`. No `header` slot, no `fullscreen`, no backdrop handler. | | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue` | New-task dialog uses `#header` slot + `:fullscreen="compact"` + valueless `close`; all its other dialogs also use valueless `close`. | | Codebase convention | Every other modal uses `close="true"` — the component must tolerate the bare form too, since the board dialogs are not the only ones being touched by that syntax. | ## 3. Change Proposal Implement the missing `modal` contract **inside `Modal.vue`** (single shared component, no call-site churn): 1. `fullscreen` prop → layout fills the viewport (`w-full h-full`, no radius, no wrapper padding). 2. `header` slot → top bar with the slot content + a close button; the existing absolute X is kept for every modal **without** a header (zero visual change for the rest of the app). 3. `close` accepts `true`/`"true"` **and** a valueless `close` (empty string) so the bare attribute used by the board dialogs shows the close button. 4. Backdrop click closes the dialog when it is closable (standard affordance, and the behaviour `SprintBoardModals` documents for non-compact mode). Dependencies/risks: `Modal.vue` is global and used by ~20 dialogs; the default branch is preserved verbatim so only the two board-dialog features change behaviour. Backdrop dismissal now applies to closable modals — intended, and it is the standard pattern. ## 4. Changes Summary | File | Change | Why | |---|---|---| | `src/components/Modal.vue` | Declares `fullscreen`, adds `header` slot bar with close button, tolerates valueless `close`, adds backdrop click-to-close, keeps the legacy absolute X for modals without header | The task dialog is opened with features the component never implemented, so it opened without title/close and never fullscreen | ## 5. The Changes ## 6. Anti-Patterns to Avoid (follow-up notes) - ❌ Passing a component attribute that is not a declared prop (`fullscreen`, `header`) and assuming it works — props must be declared or they degrade to plain DOM attributes (`$attrs`). - ❌ Relying on the `close` shorthand when the component's prop is not boolean-typed and no default is declared. - ❌ Rendering dialog chrome (title bar, close button) inside the *body* slot — it doubles the vertical cost and breaks the shared contract. ## 7. Accessibility Checklist - [x] Close button is a real `

**Summary**

1. Reported issue: the Sprint/Kanban task-creation modal could only be dismissed with its "Cancel" button — no title bar, no close affordance, no backdrop dismissal.
2. Root cause: `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardModals.vue` was opened with a `modal` contract (`#header` slot, `fullscreen` prop, valueless `close`) that the shared `src/components/Modal.vue` never implemented.
3. Fix delivered entirely in `src/components/Modal.vue`: declared `fullscreen`, rendered a header bar with an accessible ✕ button when a `header` slot exists, and tolerated the bare `close` attribute.
4. Added backdrop click-to-close for closable modals, while keeping the legacy absolute top-right ✕ so the ~20 other dialogs using the component look and behave unchanged.
5. Remaining TODO flagged: `Modal.vue` still lacks `Escape` handling, a focus trap, and `role="dialog"` / `aria-modal="true"`.
